title: Filing of Complaint with District Commission

content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer from Mumbai, purchased a defective smartphone from a local retailer. He wants to file a complaint against the retailer. Rahul can file the complaint electronically with the District Commission in Mumbai.
content.outcome: The Central Government, Central Authority, or State Government must allow Rahul to file his complaint with the District Commission, as it relates to a defective product. The complaint may be filed electronically, as prescribed by the authorities.

user_queries: How can I file a complaint against a retailer?
Can I file a complaint electronically?
What are the requirements for filing a complaint with the District Commission?
